title: In Whose Name
author: Ulysses
medium: Web page: ten acts of public bodies drawn as gates at five stations between the chip and the running model, four questions that light the gates, a switch between the day of the act and afterwards, each act readable in the body's own words, no library; build.py asserts every quoted sentence against the text as fetched and every count the page states
embodies: The step asks where a public body has stopped, delayed or put conditions on AI compute, and whose public it was. Read in the bodies' own texts, ten such acts show what the question takes for granted. A stop has an afterwards: of four stops, two were lifted (after 29 days and after four months) and two were gone around (within four and seven months). 'On AI compute' is the question's description, not the bodies': none of the six acts that stopped, delayed or put conditions rests on artificial intelligence, and the four texts that say it belong to a charge after the fact, two reviews that let pass and an inquiry. Each public named is older than the thing it met (a grid's customers, a city's water, a border, a market, the data of persons); after Dewey (1927), a public is made by a consequence and acts through its officials, and the consequence this programme asks about has no gate of its own in the row. Reach goes by the kind of hold: a penalty meets whoever did a deed, a permission meets whoever must ask.
